scope: Promote the index-level events ranked 101-161 to editorial level and settle the semantics of the battle layer by moving the excluded one-sided-killing pool into a separate, validated data layer.

events.idRule: id stays v312wd-<qid>; the provenance field is removed entirely and wikidataQid is kept
events.selection: ranks 101-161 of docs/verification-3.14/content-upgrade-ranking.json minus the one entity whose Wikidata P585 contradicts the cited articles; ranks 162-170 stay index-level for the next round

entries.titleZh: 阿莱格里亚德皮奥战役
entries.zhArticle: 阿莱格里亚德皮奥战役

civilYears.policy: Wikidata P585 is ISO 8601 astronomical (year zero exists); the project uses civil years without a year zero, so iso<=0 ships as iso-1.

excluded.reason: Wikidata P585 records 1600 while the English article dates the battle to 26 November 1614 and the Chinese article places it in the winter campaign of the Siege of Osaka (1614). An editorial entry carrying the source year would break cross-layer consistency with the battle layer, and one carrying 1600 would enshrine a date both articles contradict, so the entity stays at index level.

sourceCoverage.policy: Every entry cites at least one Wikipedia article read in this session and the Wikidata entity. An entity whose language edition has no article is cited to the editions that exist and discloses the gap in editorialNotes; no citation is invented and no entry ships with fewer than two https sources.

chinese: 第二次法蘭克-西哥德戰爭
titleFixes.policy: Titles recorded in the ranking that resolve to a disambiguation page were replaced only after reading the introduction of the replacement article and confirming it covers the same event (docs/verification-3.16/content-upgrade-titles-verified.json). Twelve English and two Chinese titles were fixed this way; no title was guessed.

structuredEntities.titleEn: Battle of the Ascent of Lebonah

斯文达克斯战役（Battle of Svindax）

remaining.note: The remaining structured index entries are the raw material for the next content round. This round took the window in rank order and stopped at 161 once 60 entries were assembled, so ranks 162-170 stay untouched. Chinese-article coverage falls steeply towards the tail of the ranking (every rank above 170 has no Chinese Wikipedia article at all), so the next round should decide per entity what is worth writing rather than working through the tail mechanically.

semanticRuling.decision: The battles layer documents combat between opposing forces. One-sided killings and massacres are a different category and are NOT merged into it; they ship as the separate atrocities layer instead.
semanticRuling.enforcedBy: scripts/places/validate-atrocities.mjs fails if any Wikidata entity id appears in both layers.

checks.name: The archive is deterministic and mirrors the editable JSON
The layer states its semantic boundary against the battle layer
Every incident has a unique id and a sourced Wikidata entity
The two layers stay disjoint by Wikidata entity id
Coordinates, years and regions come from the source record
Names are source labels: at least one is present, Chinese may be absent but is never invented
English fields contain Latin script only
The count bookkeeping matches the pool

atrocities.ui: No user interface consumes this layer in the 3.16 round; it is data plus an independent validator, as instructed.

sourceLinks.policy: Every URL cited by the 3.16 editorial batch was requested once (three attempts on failure) and the atrocity layer was sampled; the shipped files were not modified.

battleChecks.name: The battle archive is deterministic and mirrors the editable JSON
At least three hundred battles with unique ids ship in the layer
Every battle keeps valid coordinates, years and region codes from the source
Belligerents and conflicts stay arrays of source strings and are never invented
English fields contain Latin script only and Chinese fields are present
Every battle cites its Wikidata entity and any statement reference
Layer metadata records the selection policy and drop counts
The layer does not duplicate ids or coordinates of existing place datasets
